main_text.l: minus 4. mirum, quod talia fermenta ci-
bis potuique miscere sciat, quæ post le-
cum partibus cibi variis modis conjun-
ferri,&c. imitentur, uti ex oleo tartari &
am oriri videmus. Aut 5. si lentior fit il-
la fermentatio, cum certis ciborum par-
tos ex innumera congerie talium fila-
infectos ejicere, quia, nisi cibo & potui à
malo Genio ejusque servis sint mixta,
non ita liquet quomodo ad instar prio-
quod Chymicum legisse, ad cujus ideam
fidem fere superat, & à me nondum bc-

page.notes: Partial letters at the left margin belong to the adjoining page and are not transcribed. Several words are set in a worn or blotted print; "vermes" and "subitanceam" are doubtful readings. The line "fidem ... bc-" continues onto the next page.
